title: Body weight prediction of Belgian Blue crossbred using random forest.
summary: The March 2024 primary article uses random forest on 26 Belgian Blue × Friesian Holstein crossbreds measured at 11 ages. It reports chest girth as the most important body-weight predictor (24.49%) and random-forest R²=0.86 versus stepwise-regression R²=0.83. This is a small, single-cohort prediction study with no independent validation.
ai_technology: Random forest analyzes morphometric measurements to estimate cattle body weight and rank predictors.
